packages.staticAnalysis: The decompressed SWF contains a 235-byte DefineBinaryData config with the key patchURL and the Mochi URL, plus a separate 3,875,921-byte DefineBinaryData payload. ABC identifiers include mochicrypt.Preloader, mochicrypt.Payload, payloadLoader, loadBytes, and PAYLOAD_NAME. Whether patchURL is passed to Loader.load or is Mochi metadata/fallback remains unresolved; do not describe the observed SWF as a confirmed incomplete loader or confirmed self-contained game.
